description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control except Galadriel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Galadriel.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead choose any of Galadriel's modes.
